title: MeddeX：结合RAG与Gemini视觉的LLaMA-3医疗报告分析系统
summary: MeddeX是一个医疗报告分析系统，结合QLoRA微调的LLaMA-3(8B)、检索增强生成(RAG)和多模态Gemini视觉层，为医疗文档提供准确、简洁且有证据支持的摘要。系统支持文本PDF、扫描图像PDF和放射图像，引入报告范围检索、纵向报告对比引擎和自愈回填管道。评估显示相比基线模型在ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2、ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore上均有提升。
summary_en: MeddeX is a medical report analyzer combining a QLoRA fine-tuned LLaMA-3 (8B) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and a multimodal Gemini Vision layer to deliver accurate, concise, evidence-backed summaries. It handles text PDFs, scanned PDFs, and radiological images via a hybrid extraction pipeline with garbage-text detection. Features include report-scoped retrieval, longitudinal comparison, and self-healing backfill. Evaluation shows improvements in ROUGE-1 (+9.2%), ROUGE-2 (+10.0%), ROUGE-L (+11.8%), BLEU (+71.4%), and BERTScore (+0.8%) over the base model.
